lina.finance: Heads up — DatumCorp just pinged support saying their August invoice (S3: s3://invoices/prod/2024/08/2024-08-INV-0187.pdf) shows a 0.00 compute line and the PDF number matches a prior invoice. Customer is upset, they paid and now the invoice looks blank for compute. Can someone triage?

matt.billing: Ack. I can reproduce the PDF; open it and you can see compute usage row is present in the DB but renders as 0.00 in the PDF. Also saw invoice number 2024-08-INV-0187 used twice (this month + prior month).

chloe.recon: @matt.billing can you paste the billing job id and the reconciliation run id? need to tie to usage batch.

matt.billing: job id: billing-run-2024-08-27-uc-7723, recon id: recon-2024-08-27-58. attaching a short log snippet: ```INFO: generated invoice 2024-08-INV-0187 for customer_id=datumcorp; computed_total=1345.21; pdf_path=s3://invoices/prod/2024/08/2024-08-INV-0187.pdf
WARN: lineitems_summary missing for compute: NULL -> rendering 0.00
```

billing-bot: Automated alert: billing pipeline job billing-run-2024-08-27-uc-7723 completed with 1 warning (lineitems_summary NULL). Audit entry created: audit/2024/08/27/billing-run-7723.json

nate.engineering: I pulled the ETL for that run. Preliminary root cause: the dedupe/join step that creates the invoice_lineitems table is joining on invoice_ref which for a subset of raw events is NULL because of an upstream tagging regression (we stopped shipping invoice_ref on pre-aggregated usage around 2024-07-15). The downstream renderer falls back to grouping by invoice id and earlier cleanup TTL caused we regenerated an invoice id that collided with a stale id cache, so the PDF generator matched the wrong header but had no compute lines. Short version: missing join key + stale invoice id cache = zeroed line + duplicate invoice id.

nate.engineering: SQL snippet: ```-- bad join key example
SELECT ru.id, il.amount
FROM raw_usage ru
LEFT JOIN invoice_refs ir ON ir.invoice_ref = ru.invoice_ref -- invoice_ref NULL for some rows
LEFT JOIN invoice_lineitems il ON il.raw_id = ru.id
```
Fix is to use customer_id + billing_period as the primary join when invoice_ref is null. I've opened a branch nate/fix/dedupe-join and test run looks promising locally.

chloe.recon: Nice find. We need to confirm how many customers are affected before reissuing. @matt.billing can you run a scoped check for invoices in Aug where lineitems_summary NULL or compute lines sum = 0 and cross-check against invoice id duplicates?

matt.billing: Running query now, will post results in ~10m.

jo.support: FYI DatumCorp case #CS-8591. Customer asked for immediate corrected invoice + credit memo; assigned to me for comms. They asked whether this will affect revenue recognition for Aug.

sophie.ops: We should hold on any auto reissue until engineering confirms the patch and we have a count. If it's limited to a handful, manual credit + reissue may be safer. If widespread, we need rollback/patch flow. Please include finance approvers for credit memos.

matt.billing: Quick numbers: found 7 invoices in August with invoice number collisions, 12 invoices with compute lines zeroed but invoice numbers unique, overlap of 3 invoices (zeroed + duplicate). DatumCorp is one of the 3. I'll attach the invoice ids in a follow-up.

nate.engineering: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) hotfix ETL to prefer customer_id+billing_period when invoice_ref NULL (PR ready) 2) re-run the affected billing-run with dry-run mode to regenerate lineitems (non-destructive) 3) create manual credit memos for collisions where customer already paid and reissue corrected PDFs 4) run a reconciliation check and notify customers. I can get the PR through review in ~3 hours and run a dry-run overnight.

lina.finance: Sounds good. For any customer-facing reissue we need a finance approval and an audit trail (credit memo with reason: invoice generation bug). Approvers: @sophie.ops + @lina.finance. Also need to record GL impact.

sophie.ops: Approved for manual reissue + credit memo for DatumCorp once engineering confirms regenerated invoice matches DB totals. Please cc me on the credit memo. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Audit log entry created: audit/2024/08/27/issue-8591-datumcorp.json (action: mark-investigation-started)

matt.billing: Will prepare a reissue package for DatumCorp and hold until Nate posts dry-run results. Also raising a billing ops ticket: BILL-2024-4377 to track reissues/credits.

jo.support: I'll update the support ticket with an ETA that we are investigating and have approval to reissue pending validation.

nate.engineering: PR merged to staging branch nate/fix/dedupe-join, kicked off staging run (billing-run-staging-2024-08-27-xt). Will post staging artifacts: staging S3 path: s3://billing-staging/runs/billing-run-staging-2024-08-27-xt/results.json

matt.billing: Received staging results: regenerated invoice for DatumCorp now includes compute line and amounts match reconciliation table. No other collisions in staging re-run sample.

lina.finance: Proceed with manual credit + reissue for DatumCorp only for now. Matt, please attach the original invoice PDF, corrected PDF, credit memo, reconciliation export, and the audit log to the billing ticket before sending to customer.

matt.billing: Will do. ETA to send to customer after docs ready: ~4 hours.

jo.support: Noted. I'll queue a follow-up message to DatumCorp explaining next steps + expected corrected invoice delivery window.

sophie.ops: Thx all. Postmortem please once we validate the root cause and have a permanent deploy plan.

lina.finance: Agreed — please include a recommendation for a pre-flight check to detect invoice_ref-null runs and a warning to block PDF publication when lineitems_summary NULL.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem-due in 7 days for BILL-2024-4377

matt.billing: Thread summary: root cause = missing invoice_ref + stale id collision; scope = small (dozen-ish invoices); action = staged fix merged, manual reissue+credit for DatumCorp approved, ticket BILL-2024-4377 tracking.

jo.support: Closing loop on support ticket note: customer update drafted, waiting for corrected PDF + credit memo.
